system.description:
You touch a willing creature putting it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death.

For the jutsu’s duration, or until you use an action to touch the target and dismiss this jutsu, the target appears dead to all outward inspection and to jutsu used to determine the targets status. The target is Blinded and Incapacitated, and its speed drops to 0. The target has resistance to all damage except psychic damage. If the target is diseased or Envenomed when you case this jutsu, or becomes diseased or Envenomed while under this Jutsu's effect, the disease and poison have no effect until this jutsu ends.
